highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: It adds variable-font and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle and default-typeface resolution. This is a breaking release with several behavioral and Vulkan interop changes — read the breaking changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface
breaking.body: Compiles unchanged but MeasureText/drawing on a default-constructed SKFont now uses an empty (0-glyph) typeface instead of lazily resolving the platform default, so measured widths silently become 0. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and use Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SKPaint.Typeface is now always non-null (SKTypeface.Default) rather than null. Text still renders correctly, but code that used a null check to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires — use Typeface.IsEmpty instead.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null on Android. For a strict "was it found" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete
breaking.body: The long overload used to silently truncate out-of-range offsets to a 32-bit int; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with a validated, in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, not throwing) if the instance or backend context declare only 1.0. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0) before calling CreateVulkan.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from this interop struct. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped and lost value-equality
breaking.body: The property now returns GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (with a new Components field) instead of the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which also lost its IEquatable implementation and equality operators. Update field-layout-dependent code and replace equality comparisons with manual field comparisons.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine across milestones 132, 133, 147, and finally 148, merging several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way — the biggest engine jump since v3.
Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette selection, and improves variable font robustness overall.
Adds SKWebpEncoder support for encoding animated WebP images.
Adds SKStream.GetData() to convert a stream to SKData without an intermediate copy.

bullets.lead: HBColor and other missing API wrappers
bullets.detail: Adds an HBColor struct for the proper hb_color_t representation, plus several other missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support extended to surface drawing
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions.

bullets.lead: Legacy paint/font APIs promoted to errors
bullets.detail: Obsoletes the remaining legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and promotes them (and other pre-v4 obsoletes) from warnings to compile errors, completing the v3-to-v4 obsolete-API cleanup.

bullets.lead: Pixel access stride and offset fixes
bullets.detail: SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride instead of the pixel width, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload no longer uses Height where Width was needed.
Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: Fixes a packaging issue that left the WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers.

bullets.lead: MAUI TabBar rendering fix on Android
bullets.detail: Fixes SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch inside a MAUI TabBar on Android.

bullets.lead: Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: Moves default-typeface resolution into managed code, fixing inconsistent behavior across platforms (including Android API 36+).

Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton native instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, and corrects Apple TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps).
Updates the bundled zlib, libpng, libexpat/expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, and harfbuzz to their latest releases, picking up upstream security and bug fixes.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPath finalizer fix, variable font support, moving default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and bumping Skia through milestones 132 and 147
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Contributed a fix landing in this release
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Contributed a fix landing in this release
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar on Android

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opens the v4 line, bumping Skia to milestone 132 and adding variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 adds color font palette support, animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData(), and fixes the SKPath finalizer crash.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 bumps Skia to milestone 147, reworks the singleton lifecycle, and refreshes the bundled native dependencies (zlib, libpng, expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype).
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate updates Skia to milestone 148, fixes the pixel-span stride/offset bugs, promotes the remaining legacy paint/font obsoletes to compile errors, and updates harfbuzz to 14.2.0, finalizing the first stable v4 release.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz binding to 14.2.0, adding variable font shaping support and the new HBColor struct alongside the SkiaSharp v4 upgrade.
